stem.text: A motor is required to operate at a distance of $800\,\text{m}$ from its power supply. The motor requires a potential difference (p.d.) of $16.0\,\text{V}$ and a current of $0.60\,\text{A}$ to operate.
Two wires are used to supply power to the motor as shown.

stem.alt: Diagram of a power supply box connected to a motor box by two wires, with arrows showing the direction of current in each wire. Printed labels: power supply; wires; 800 m (dimension arrow); motor.

stem.text: The resistance of each of these wires is $0.0050\,\Omega$ per metre.
What is the minimum output p.d. of the power supply?
